cases.question: Where is the Sunken Vault entrance and what levels is it for?

reference.text: The Sunken Vault entrance is in Mossback Ridge. The dungeon is tuned for levels 28 to 34 and takes five players.

cases.question: How long is the Ember Rite attunement chain?

reference.text: The Ember Rite attunement has 9 quests, starts at Cinder Post and takes about 3 hours.

cases.question: How much does the first mount cost?

reference.text: The basic mount costs 60 gold at level 40 from the Stablemaster in Dawnhold. Riding skill is trained separately.
Dungeon lockouts reset daily at 04:00 server time as of the 2026-11-10 hotfix.

cases.question: How many talent points do I have at level 40 and what does dual spec cost?

reference.text: At level 40 a character has spent 31 talent points. Dual spec unlocks at level 40 and costs 10 gold.

cases.question: Which professions can make the bigger bags?

reference.text: Tailoring makes bags of up to 16 slots from Mooncloth. Leatherworking makes ammo pouches, not general bags.

cases.question: What does the Frostward spell do for a mage?

reference.text: Frostward absorbs the next 120 damage from a single school for 30 seconds and has a 45 second cooldown.
